newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - Hong Kong Newspaper Editorials - Apr 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Hong Kong Newspaper Editorials - Apr 14.

text.p: There are 78 days to go before the British colony reverts to China. These are highlights of comments in the Hong Kong press. The views expressed are those of the newspapers quoted and do not represent an editorial viewpoint of Reuters.

The MING PAO DAILY said human rights was one of Hong Kong people's greatest concerns. If the human rights situation in the mainland did not improve, it will be difficult to allay their concerns regarding Hong Kong's reversion to China, the paper said.

The Beijing-backed TA KUNG PAO said the provisional legislature has an ample legal basis and its composition is widely representative. Now with its rules of operaton in place, it must carry out its authority according to law and fulfill its historic mission, the paper said.

The English-language HONG KONG STANDARD said there was an argument that mainland children who will have right of abode in Hong Kong after July 1 should be given two-way permits but continue their education on the mainland. This would ease the pressure on Hong Kong schools but at the same time enable the children to spend quality time with their families here.
